name: Iverron
summary: In Shadowglen, Iverron lies stricken by spider venom. His plight warns of growing corruption within Teldrassil.

sections.title: A Bitter Bite
sections.body: Iverron wandered beneath Shadowglen’s quiet canopies when webwood spiders bit him. Their venom left the young night elf unable to return to safety on his own. The spiders once shared the glade in peace, but now they grow increasingly aggressive.

sections.title: Desperate Remedies
sections.body: Iverron’s companions and local healers seek a cure using hyacinth mushrooms, moonpetal lilies, and webwood ichor. Together, these woodland ingredients make an antidote. His survival depends on their swift work.

faq.answer: Iverron is a young night elf in Shadowglen, within Teldrassil. Poisonous creatures bit him as he wandered the woodland, and he needs urgent aid to survive.
Aggressive webwood spiders in Shadowglen bit Iverron and poisoned him with debilitating venom.
Iverron is cured with an antidote made from hyacinth mushrooms, moonpetal lilies, and webwood ichor from the spiders.
You can find Iverron in Shadowglen, a secluded glade in Teldrassil where young night elves begin their training.
Iverron’s friend Dirania Silvershine asks for help gathering antidote ingredients, then asks that the antidote be brought back to him before it loses its potency.

faq.q: Why are the spiders in Shadowglen so hostile?
faq.answer: Shadowglen’s spiders have grown hostile as part of an unnatural malady spreading through Teldrassil. It warps normally reclusive beasts into violent predators.

angles.text: As a night elf taking your first steps outside Aldrassil, you can see in Iverron’s misfortune how quickly Teldrassil’s wilds are falling out of balance.
As a druid studying in Shadowglen, you can see Iverron’s poisoning as a symptom of a deeper affliction gripping nature. The remedy draws on the glade’s flora and fauna.
As an herbalist, you can help preserve life by gathering Shadowglen’s plants quickly; Iverron’s survival depends on it.
